Tabs

Tabs organize content into multiple panels where only one panel is visible at a time. They help users switch between different views or sections without leaving the page.

Basic Tabs

A simple tab interface with clickable tabs and content panels.

Content for Tab 1. This panel is currently active and visible.

Content for Tab 2. Click the tab to switch to this panel.

Content for Tab 3. Each tab can contain different content.

HTML
<div class="zak-tabs">
    <div class="zak-tabs-list" role="tablist">
        <button class="zak-tab active" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="panel1">Tab 1</button>
        <button class="zak-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel2">Tab 2</button>
        <button class="zak-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel3">Tab 3</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-tab-panels">
        <div class="zak-tab-panel active" role="tabpanel" id="panel1">Content 1</div>
        <div class="zak-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel2" hidden>Content 2</div>
        <div class="zak-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel3" hidden>Content 3</div>
    </div>
</div>

CSS Classes

Tab styles are controlled through these CSS classes.

HTML
/* Tabs Container */
.zak-tabs                    /* Base tabs */
.zak-tabs-pills              /* Pill/rounded variant */
.zak-tabs-vertical           /* Vertical layout */
.zak-tabs-justified          /* Full-width tabs */
.zak-tabs-bordered           /* Bordered panel container */

/* Tabs List */
.zak-tabs-list               /* Tab button container */

/* Individual Tab */
.zak-tab                     /* Base tab button */
.zak-tab.active              /* Active tab */

/* Panels */
.zak-tab-panels              /* Panel container */
.zak-tab-panel               /* Individual panel */
.zak-tab-panel.active        /* Active/visible panel */

JavaScript

Handle tab switching with JavaScript.

HTML
function switchTab(tabsId, index) {
    const tabs = document.getElementById(tabsId);
    const tabButtons = tabs.querySelectorAll('.zak-tab');
    const tabPanels = tabs.querySelectorAll('.zak-tab-panel');

    tabButtons.forEach((btn, i) => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === index);
    });

    tabPanels.forEach((panel, i) => {
        panel.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
        panel.hidden = i !== index;
    });
}

// Keyboard navigation for tabs
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-tabs-list').forEach(list => {
    list.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        const tabs = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll('.zak-tab'));
        const currentIndex = tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement);
        let newIndex = currentIndex;

        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') newIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
        if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') newIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        if (e.key === 'Home') newIndex = 0;
        if (e.key === 'End') newIndex = tabs.length - 1;

        if (newIndex !== currentIndex) {
            e.preventDefault();
            tabs[newIndex].focus();
            tabs[newIndex].click();
        }
    });
});

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using tabs.

  • Use role="tablist" on the tab container, role="tab" on each tab, and role="tabpanel" on each panel.
  • Set aria-selected="true" on the active tab and "false" on inactive tabs.
  • Use aria-controls to link each tab to its panel, and aria-labelledby on panels linking back to their tab.
  • Use hidden attribute on inactive panels instead of CSS-only hiding.
  • Support keyboard navigation with arrow keys, Home, and End.
  • Use tabindex="0" on the active tab and tabindex="-1" on inactive tabs.
HTML
<div class="zak-tabs">
    <div class="zak-tabs-list" role="tablist">
        <button class="zak-tab active" role="tab" id="tab-1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="panel-1" tabindex="0">Tab 1</button>
        <button class="zak-tab" role="tab" id="tab-2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel-2" tabindex="-1">Tab 2</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-tab-panels">
        <div class="zak-tab-panel active" role="tabpanel" id="panel-1" aria-labelledby="tab-1">Content 1</div>
        <div class="zak-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-2" aria-labelledby="tab-2" hidden>Content 2</div>
    </div>
</div>
